ModMetaData.name: Avoid Mechanoid Sensors
ModMetaData.author: lemonade
ModMetaData.description:
Makes humanlike pawns avoid pathing near dormant mechanoid proximity sensors (activator proximity sensors) so caravans and visitors are less likely to wake dormant mechanoids.
Known limitation: this is pathing avoidance, not exit-target selection. In some edge-of-map cases, traders or visitors may still choose a bad exit route and trigger a sensor.
